scope: Skip only these16 opcodes when proving omitted CPU canonical rows dead; actual dispatcher still executes all opcodes and GROUP construction still stops at every state/list boundary. No source edit.

0xd7.name: TEXTURE
0xd7.effect: Writes vertex-state epoch and future UV scales.

0xfd.name: SETTIMG
0xfd.effect: Writes future texture source pointer and format size.

0xd9.name: GEOMETRYMODE
0xd9.effect: Writes vertex-state epoch and future geometry mode.

0xfb.name: SETENVCOLOR
0xfb.effect: Writes environment RGBA and GPU vertex-cache stale mask.

0xf5.name: SETTILE
0xf5.effect: Writes texture tile/load metadata and change flags; no upload.

0xf2.name: SETTILESIZE
0xf2.effect: Writes texture tile bounds and change flags.

0xf3.name: LOADBLOCK
0xf3.effect: Writes loaded-texture source/size/change metadata; no GPU upload or vertex read.

0xf4.name: LOADTILE
0xf4.effect: Writes loaded-texture metadata/tile bounds; no GPU upload or vertex read.

0xf0.name: LOADTLUT
0xf0.effect: Writes palette pointer and texture-change flags.

0xfa.name: SETPRIMCOLOR
0xfa.effect: Writes primitive RGBA and GPU vertex-cache stale mask.

0xfc.name: SETCOMBINE
0xfc.effect: Writes combine mode from pure color-combiner decoding.

0xf8.name: SETFOGCOLOR
0xf8.effect: Writes fog RGBA; this backend binds a no-op gpu_set_fog_color callback.

0xe6.name: LOADSYNC
0xe6.effect: No explicit sync case in this backend; default only invalidates material memo.

0xe7.name: PIPESYNC
0xe7.effect: No explicit sync case in this backend; default only invalidates material memo.

0xe8.name: TILESYNC
0xe8.effect: No explicit sync case in this backend; default only invalidates material memo.

0xe9.name: FULLSYNC
0xe9.effect: No explicit sync case in this backend; default only invalidates material memo.

excluded: SETOTHERMODE_H0xe3 and SETOTHERMODE_L0xe2 remain barriers: their shared handler may invoke canonical fog materialization. An omitted-slot/fog-mask invariant could support a separate proof, but it is outside this sixteen-op scope.

Every other state/draw/unknown opcode, malformed VTX, TRI referencing any still-pending slot, nonimmutable command/target, second external caller return, root-list end, cycle/step/stack exhaustion remains a rejection.
build_contract: TARGET_OPENFPGA, GFX_GPU_GEOMETRY_WORKER_APP=0, current F3DEX_GBI_2E and actual gfx_gpu rendering backend.
The alternate geometry-worker-app pre-dispatch attribute-flush branch is inactive; do not reuse this whitelist under a different build without re-audit.
SETFOGCOLOR safety binds the actual no-op callback; a different rendering backend is not covered.
ownership_and_order_obligations: Async success already clears cpu_fog_pending for all omitted written slots and begins with no lazy alias dependency in those slots. Whitelisted commands do not change either pending mask or read canonical vertices.

A later partial VTX first materializes old live survivors and drops overwritten lazy/fog rows as before. The proof removes only overwritten slots from its pending mask. A future TRI mentioning any remaining slot rejects regardless of material/cull state.

State changes remain CPU-executed and invalidate material/update epochs/cache flags exactly as now. No shared-context GROUP may cross a state opcode: immutable task eligibility is still checked at each actual material context.

Prepared GROUP input/context/material and repair descriptors remain immutable and ordered ahead of subsequently emitted GPU state. No publication, source-pool fence, lease yield, texture reuse wait or repair path is removed.
The proof may read only immutable command bytes. Mutable caller storage cannot be cached as if immutable, even if a historical snapshot suggests an overwrite.
cache_design: Keep source-only static MeshTask.dead_after only for proofs needing no caller. Never store a contextual result there.

For caller-aware proofs, pass the immediate actual return_command; reject a second external return. Static nested G_DL calls use a bounded local return stack; tail branches keep the current continuation.

Cache exact task source plus exact immutable return_command, with exact comparison after any hash. Bind GROUP cache entries to the same contextual proof identity; context-entry replacement must not authorize stale group reuse.
Group end pointer remains inside its current physical list, preserving original CPU control-flow/state execution.
coverage_limit: Source-bound cold traversal can establish caller-aware coverage. Warm continuation graph is not captured; only same-list warm counts are available. Structural candidates are not confirmed material admission or measured cycle savings.
if_implemented_tests: Actual-helper proof tests with each whitelisted opcode between load and overwrite, partial overwrites then forbidden pending TRI, all explicitly excluded opcodes, malformed counts/indices, step and stack limits.
Same callee under overwrite versus live-TRI/state/mutable callers must not share a positive proof; nested call/branch/return, exact-key collisions and cache replacement.

Before/after dispatcher traces must still include every state opcode in order. Verify material/cull changes, fog alpha, GPU cache staleness, texture/source lifetimes, repair and canonical state with strict full-native oracle.
